title: rosa × schleicheri var. beckii
intro: Rosa × schleicheri var. beckii, commonly known as Damask rose, is a fragrant and flowering plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to alleviate stress, promote relaxation, and support healthy skin. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × schleicheri var. beckii include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as geraniol and linalool, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
